scripts.test:quick: pnpm --filter neozipkit run test && pnpm --filter neozip-blockchain run test
scripts.publish:dry-run: pnpm --filter neozipkit publish:dry-run && pnpm --filter neozip-blockchain publish:dry-run
scripts.publish:neozipkit: pnpm --filter neozipkit run build && pnpm --filter neozipkit exec npx --yes npm@11 publish --access public
scripts.publish:neozip-blockchain: pnpm --filter neozip-blockchain run build && pnpm --filter neozip-blockchain exec npx --yes npm@11 publish --access public
